title: Decision Nº 051/002/2003 CC.D of February 11, 2003
text:
KINGDOM OF CAMBODIA 
Nation Religion King 
 
The Constitutional Council 
 ***** 
CASE 
Nº 059/003/2003 
Of February 4, 2003 
Decision 
Nº 051/002/2003 CC.D 
Of February 11, 2003 
 
 
The Constitutional Council 
 
- Seen the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia 
 
- Seen Preah Reach Kram Nº CS/RKM/0498/06 of April 8, 1998 on the Organization 
and the Functioning of the Constitutional Council; 
 
- Seen the articles 50 N, 54 N and 62 N of Preah Reach Kram Nº NS/RKM/0902/017 
of September 17, 2002 on the Amendment of the law on the Elections of the 
Members of the National Assembly; 
 
 Having heard the reporting member, 
 Having deliberated in compliance with the law, 
 
- Whereas the complaint of Mr. LY RY, representative of Ms. POEU SOPHOAN, 
complied with the legal procedures; 
 
- Whereas the Constitutional Council has received the complaint within the legal 
time limit; 
 
- Whereas the Hearing Council (formation of judgment of the Constitutional 
Council) has interrogated the two parties and witnesses; 
 
- Whereas the witnesses KONG THAN and EK RATANA, know Ms. POEU 
SOPHOAN very well; 
 
- Whereas Ms. POEU SOPHOAN does not possess any document proving her 
Khmer nationality required by the articles 50 N and 54 N of the law on the 
Amendment of the law on the Elections of the Members of the National Assembly; 
and that, during the public session of the Hearing Council on February 11, 2003, 
Ms. POEU SOPHOAN repeated that she possesses 1998 and 2002 election cards; 
 
- Whereas the deadline for voter registration is not expired yet; 
 
Decides 
In the presence of the parties 
 
Article 1: Is ad missible the complaint of February 4, 2003 of Mr. LY RY, representative 
of Ms. POEU SOPHOAN. 
 
Article 2: Is rejected the decision of the National Electoral Committee (NEC) of February 
30,2003 on the questions of witnesses but is confirmed the same NEC decision in its 
partdealing with the documents on Khmer nationality. Should Ms. POEU SOPHOAN be 
able to show the electoral card to the Boeung Salang Commune Council before the 
registration d eadline for the voters on the 2003 Elections of the Members of the National 
Assembly, Ms. POEU SOPHOAN shall be registered. 
 
Article 3: This decision pronounced in public hearing in Phnom Penh on February 11, 003 
shall be final without recourse, shall hav e authority over all instituted powers stipulated in 
the Constitution and shall be published in the «Journal Officiel». 
 
 
 
 Phnom Penh, February 11, 2003 
 For the Constitutional Council 
 The President 
 
 Signed and Sealed 
 
 BIN CHHIN 
 
 
 
 
 
 ( Non -official translation )
summary: Decision Nº 051/002/2003 CC.D of February 11, 2003 (Mr. Ly Ry, representative of SAM RAIN SY Party, complaines on the registration of Miss POEU SOPHOAN)
